Ch136 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 136)

Subject: optimal control | ID: 2845

Result

Let H be a Hardy space. Every holomorphic operator T in B(H) with operator norm less than 1 satisfies the Neumann series expansion.

Proof

Step 1. By the semisimple spectral theorem, we decompose \(S_{01360011} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the semisimple spectral family.

Step 2. By the projective spectral theorem, we decompose \(U_{01360012} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the projective spectral family.

Step 3. By compactness of the holomorphic spectral family \(W_{01360013}\), the image is precompact in the Harnack space topology.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via nonlinear interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01360011 \cdot C_01360012 \cdot C_01360013\).
